d: Long, flowing cyan hair with straight bangs and a high ponytail. Calm, narrow light-pink eyes on a youthful, mature face. A slender build wearing a white sleeveless dress with a chest cutout and a white neck warmer, draped in a large, oversized deep-red hooded cloak. Accessories include a silver bracelet on the right wrist, a silver anklet on the right ankle, and a black rectangular sign held in the left hand.
